metadata.name: MTA Bus Stop Ridership Estimates: Beginning 2024
metadata.description: This dataset includes estimated boardings for bus stop level ridership. Each record represents ridership activity for a route, direction, and stop during a specific month-day of week-hour. Boarding estimates are derived from Automatic Passenger Counters (APCs) that are in use on the buses along MTA’s routes.

columns.name: Month
columns.description: Represents the month in which the metrics are being calculated (formatted as yyyy-mm-dd).

columns.name: Day Type
columns.description: Whether the day of the week is a weekday or weekend.

columns.name: Hour
columns.description: Represents the hour of the time period that the metrics are being calculated.

columns.name: Trip Type
columns.description: The type of bus service provided: EXP (Express), LCL/LTD (Local/Limited), SBS (Select Bus Service).

columns.name: Stop ID
columns.description: Identifies each individual bus stop along the route using a distinct numeric code.

columns.name: Direction ID
columns.description: Identifies the direction the bus is going on the route.

columns.name: Stop Sequence
columns.description: Identifier for where in a bus route’s sequence of stops the route-stop is.

columns.name: Estimated Ridership
columns.description: Estimated count of the number of passengers boarding. Value can be NULL if an estimate cannot be provided.

Dataset Summary.Granularity: One row per day, hour, route, stop, stop sequence.
